_about: Hesham's own block capitals, written on canvases on 24 Nov 2026 (strokes as saved, points rounded). first, second, third: HELLO. fourth: HELLO with a 2.4 s pause after the H and a four-sided O. tiltedA: an A turned about 20 degrees, a one-stroke peak and a bar. roundB, angularB: two Bs, the angular one once misread as E. Used to check the split, features, cards and grouping on real writing (T51-T53).
